messages:
sophia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need owners + one-line ETAs for GPU capacity + autoscale remediations so I can add to the action tracker by EOD.

mike: I'll own scheduler tuning (fair_share, preemption thresholds). Short canary plan included.

raj: I'll take the quota path with cloud vendor + sales fallback. Will open support ticket.

_tess: I'll implement a small staging canary (10%) and add p99 perf alert. Also will capture baseline metrics._

nate: I'll draft an emergency headroom runbook section and propose a surge oncall rota.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-3177 \u2014 "Vendor quota request for surge headroom" (assignee: raj). https://tracker.redwood.ai/INF-3177

mike: Plan (short): test fair_share weights +/-20%, lower preempt_threshold on latency-critical lanes, feature-flag rollout. Canary: 10% traffic, 48h. ETA: 10 business days (draft next Thu).

raj: Vendor request path: open support + sales escalation if delayed. Fallback: enable reserved burst capacity. ETA: 2 business days to file initial request.

_tess: Alert (PromQL):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, tenant))
```
Alert: p99 > 450ms for 10m -> page oncall. ETA: 3 days for alert + dashboard.

nate: Runbook stub (emergency steps): 1) Route non-critical tenants to quantized model variant; 2) Increase autoscale max_instances (if quota); 3) Trigger pre-warmed pool for 30m; 4) If still saturated -> enable reserved capacity via sales. Will PR to infra/runbooks. ETA: 5 days.

sophia: TL;DR owners + ETAs to add to tracker: quota=raj (2d, INF-3177), scheduler= mike (10bd), canary+alert=tess (3d), runbook+nights=nate (5d). Please add a 1-line rollback per owner for SRE to run during surge.

mike: Rollback: revert fair_share to previous commit, disable feature flag, set max_batch_size=8.

raj: Rollback: request emergency uplift via sales + enable reserved capacity window; route to alternate region if vendor blocks.

_tess: Rollback: mute canary routing and revert traffic split, run quick smoke A/B to validate baseline.

nate: I'll add console paths + escalation contacts to the runbook PR.

sophia: I'll import these into the remediation tracker and schedule a 30m sync next Tue 11:00. Meeting invite incoming. :calendar:

ops-bot: Meeting created: "GPU headroom follow-up" Tue 11:00  attendees: sophia, mike, raj, tess, nate

mike: ack

raj: ack

tess: ack

nate: ack

sophia: Thanks everyone  post brief updates here as you make progress so the tracker stays live.
